subject: Archaeology
title: LiDAR Reveals a Maya Megacity
description: A 60-second lesson on LiDAR Reveals a Maya Megacity.

hook.text: In 2018, lasers fired from airplanes over Guatemala's jungle revealed something no one expected.

buildup.text: LiDAR stripped away the tree canopy digitally, exposing 60,000 hidden structures beneath the forest.

discovery.text: Roads, fortresses, farms, and pyramids appeared — a Maya civilization far larger than anyone had estimated.

twist.text: The data showed the Maya lowlands held up to 11 million people, not the 1–2 million previously believed.

climax.text: One scan in weeks accomplished what would have taken a century of jungle trekking on foot.

punchline.text: Lasers from the sky rewrote what we knew about an entire civilization.

quiz.question: What did the 2018 LiDAR survey of Guatemala's jungle reveal?
options: A single massive pyramid larger than any previously known
60,000 hidden structures showing the Maya civilization was far larger than estimated
Evidence of a previously unknown civilization predating the Maya
